svg.title: miniRT 3D world: coordinate system, camera basis vectors, and scene objects
svg.desc: Diagram showing the right-handed 3D coordinate system used in miniRT, with the camera at origin, its three basis vectors (forward/right/up), and example scene objects (sphere, plane, light)
svg.text: Part 2 — camera position and the three basis vectors
Part 3 — everything in world space (top-down view)
